scenes.rot_convention: crop(file) ~= numpy.rot90(crop(rep), scene_rot_k), counter-clockwise; scene_swap_hv = k odd: copy labels with h<->v (and warp_dir) swapped
scenes.rot_method: crop NCC vs the rep re-rectified with rolled corners (CLAHE grey + gradient magnitude, sigma 2 px at 256 px/in, 128 px/in, inner 84%), as aug1016

iaa_policy.rule: 20 distinct scenes, reps only; strata = resolution (full: rep >= 3000 px on the long side, else quarter_only) x frozen counter weave guess (plain / twill / other = satin, other, unknown); largest-remainder proportional allocation; within a cell numpy RandomState(seed).choice of the sorted ids, cells in sorted order

iaa_history.reason: v1 drew 20 FILES incl. same-scene pairs (10, 33) and (61, 69) and non-rep copies; replaced by 20 distinct scenes (reps) while no record was done (done records on disk at retirement: 0)

attention.rule: per axis D = exp(max(|ln ours - m|, median_i |ln e_i - m|)) - 1, m = median of ln counts of the available estimators (ours, log_gabor, gpt_p1, cnn_v5b0 where valid); points: max D >= 33% -> 2, >= 10% -> 1; px per yarn = S / exp(m) of the finer axis < 4 -> 2, < 5 -> 1; eta < gate r_min -> 2, < p05 of the 150 clean photos -> 1; sat240 > 1% -> 1; ours' confidence < gate t_c -> 1; level: >= 2 high, 1 medium, 0 low. Computed for scene reps only, from predictions only (no annotation is read).
attention.ui: badge + reasons for high and medium; nothing for low; never on IAA-subset scenes, blind records or copies; no count is ever shown; 'High attention first' lists the reps where it is visible

estimators.ours: methods/predictions_ours_150.csv h_count / v_count (the frozen counter; its dots are the proposals)
estimators.gpt_p1: vlm/results/rect150_P1_predictions_long.csv model gpt-6.1-sol, parse_ok; vertical = H, horizontal = V
estimators.cnn_v5b0: cnn/runs_aug/report/real150_aug_wide_heldout.csv cnn-aug-V5-b0__v = H, __h = V (blank on its fine-tuning scenes -> left out)
